title: Hierarchical AI-Meteorologist: LLM-Agent System for Multi-Scale and Explainable Weather Forecast Reporting

claim.summary: Hierarchical AI-Meteorologist aggregates weather forecasts across hourly/six-hour/daily scales and separates factual meteorological interpretation from user-facing report writing.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; time series reporting

modules.name: Variable-aware multiscale temporal aggregation
modules.scope_reason: The non-LLM Assistant implements variable-aware windowed means, extrema, sums and circular means before report generation. This module denotes that numerical aggregation operation; the forecast-lead-time context selection and report schema belong to the downstream reporting procedure.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "To enable interpretation at multiple time scales"

modules.name: Evidence-linked weather reporting
modules.scope_reason: The meteorologist/writer stages interpret supplied forecast tables and adapt reports to user domains; they do not generate the baseline forecast.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "The Meteorologist block"

modules.name: Cached REST artifacts and API fallback
modules.scope_reason: Caching, retries, schema validation and completeness checks are reusable service mechanisms.
